not_this: An ordinary restart is separate from service registration.
Package identity does not prove visible runtime behavior.
Bootstrap does not authorize installation or activation.

scope.purpose: Provide the macOS shell and package/install lifecycle while keeping source, built, installed and running identity separate.
scope.boundary: Owner of desktop delivery as specified by docs/installed-runtime-parity.md; shared runtime and neighboring contracts remain explicit dependencies.
non_goals: Treating ordinary restart as service registration
Claiming visible runtime behavior from package identity
Installing or activating a runtime as part of metadata bootstrap
